safepaths.gui.server_config: This server's settings are managed by its owner. Edit config/safepaths-common.toml on the server.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.safepaths: Let journeys shape the world: footsteps form paths, roads speed up travel, and unused trails return to nature. Customize your paths and pace, with optional MineColonies support for citizen-made paths that respect colony permissions.
neoforge.screen.mods.info.description.sa: Let journeys shape the world: footsteps form paths, roads speed up travel, and unused trails return to nature. Customize your paths and pace, with optional MineColonies support for citizen-made paths that respect colony permissions.

safepaths.configuration.title: Safepaths Settings
safepaths.configuration.Path Settings.to: Configure path creation and speed boost behavior
safepaths.gui.conversions.title: Path Conversions
safepaths.gui.restore_defaults.title: Restore Default Conversions
safepaths.gui.restore_defaults.message: Are you sure you want to restore default conversions? Any custom block entries will be reset.
config.safepaths.requiredPasses.tooltip: Passes needed to form a path. Standing still or jumping in place does not add passes.
config.safepaths.constructionTime.toolti: Time from the first counted step to reach the required passes. Later steps do not extend it. 24,000 ticks is one Minecraft day.
config.safepaths.enableSpeedBoost.toolti: Give living entities a movement speed bonus on recognized roads.
config.safepaths.speedMultiplier.tooltip: Global bonus in percent (20 = +20%). Rules without their own speed inherit this value. The config file uses 0.2 for 20%.
config.safepaths.decayTime.tooltip: Ticks without authorized traffic before a tracked path restores its original terrain. 72,000 ticks is three Minecraft days.
config.safepaths.customConversions.toolt: Source block -> path block. Use the same block on both sides for a permanent speed road.
safepaths.gui.rule.speed_help: Blank: global bonus. 0: no bonus. Range: 0–500%.
safepaths.gui.rule.invalid: Use valid block IDs. Bonus: 0–500%, or blank to inherit.
safepaths.gui.rule.duplicate: This source already has a rule. Edit that rule instead.
safepaths.gui.rule.missing: Missing block: rule kept inactive until its mod is installed.
safepaths.gui.rule.unsafe_target: Choose a solid road block without block-entity data.
safepaths.gui.rule.protected_source: Protected source: inventories and farmland cannot become paths.
config.safepaths.enablePathCreation.tool: Footsteps can form new paths. When disabled, authorized traffic still refreshes existing roads.
config.safepaths.enablePathDecay.tooltip: Unused tracked paths return to their original terrain. Disabling decay preserves records and elapsed time; expired paths may revert when re-enabled.
config.safepaths.sneakPreventsPathCreati: Sneaking players add no construction passes. They still refresh existing roads.
safepaths.inspect.decay_disabled: Decay is disabled; the path record is retained
safepaths.inspect.support: Restoration is waiting for safe support
safepaths.inspect.tracked: Tracked road; authorized traffic refreshes its decay countdown
safepaths.gui.settings.reset_message: Reset all settings and block conversions? Changes are applied when you press Done.
safepaths.gui.rule.empty: No conversions yet. Add one below.
